definition.def: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.
examples: ...the need to rectify what is an obvious injustice.
Determining how he will conduct his presidency isn't quite so obvious.

definition.def: If you describe something that someone says as obvious, you are being critical of it because you think it is unnecessary or shows lack of imagination. [disapproval]
examples: There are some very obvious phrases that we should know better than to use.

definition.def: If you say that someone is stating the obvious, you mean that they are saying something that everyone already knows and understands.
examples: It may be stating the obvious, but most teleworking at present is connected with computers.
